paragraphs.text: Shoppers heading to Pontotoc’s Christmas open house Sunday can expect sunshine and temperatures in the mid-70s. The Chamber lists the Nov. 22 event from noon to 5 p.m. The National Weather Service’s Saturday afternoon forecast now puts the county’s chance of showers in the evening.

Friday’s county forecast had included a 30% chance of showers Sunday afternoon. In the update issued at 3:05 p.m. Saturday, forecasters give Pontotoc County a 50% chance of rain Sunday night, with an evening shower possible before winds turn northerly. Gusts could reach 20 mph after midnight, with temperatures falling to the mid-40s.

By Monday afternoon, the county is expected to be about 15 degrees cooler than on Sunday. The forecast calls for a high around 60, with morning clouds giving way to mostly sunny skies and a north wind of 10 to 15 mph. Monday night’s low is expected in the mid-30s.

The outlook for Thanksgiving morning has also edged warmer. Friday’s bulletin called for upper 20s overnight Wednesday. Saturday’s update puts that low in the lower 30s and keeps Thanksgiving Day mostly sunny, with a high in the mid-50s.
